**Access boundary:** Public reading surface.

Public UI/localised content implemented; current candidate changes are local until released.

**Surfaces:** Public browser/static documents and four-language frontend/video catalogues; preview has no business bindings.

[Read the engineering guide](/engineering/contributing/) · [All features](/features/)

## Capabilities

<ol>
<li id="feature-ff0e4dfc53ef">Product presentation, feature/role explanations and assistant guides</li>
<li id="feature-6bb5198db68c">Four-language assistant hub and manual installation guides; OAuth, workflows and publication have separate qualification</li>
<li id="feature-f4f755e13298">Package download and version/SHA-256 manifest; compare published and local candidate versions; download grants no consent</li>
<li id="feature-f65f4c5ad4a6">Journal, articles, legal notices and privacy</li>
<li id="feature-0df48bf22de1">French, English, German and Luxembourgish frontend/video localisation</li>
<li id="feature-2fb09b49584a">Separate saved personal preference and anonymous visitor choice</li>
<li id="feature-12f40fd1b2eb">Twelve localised films, posters, captions and actual durations</li>
<li id="feature-36d71e0db77c">Static pages, canonical URLs, sitemap and language alternatives</li>
<li id="feature-f582030ca078">Fictional public preview isolated from the backend</li>
<li id="feature-c5475b39f98a">Multilingual social cards and reader sharing controls</li>
<li id="feature-7d0f587da524">Public error documents retain real HTTP status with 17 dedicated four-language messages and 4xx/5xx fallback; only eligible public failures, no status-selector/demo endpoint</li>
<li id="feature-93e9a29f288b">Original responsive navigation/access/service artwork, retained masters/provenance and accessible text independent of bitmap</li>
<li id="feature-7901a73ca9a7">Shared public header/footer/legal navigation; the mobile menu closes on an unhandled Escape after pointer or keyboard opening and restores trigger focus; English canonical paths and anchors with explicit legacy path and public-hash aliases</li>
<li id="feature-070eb59ffb63">English source copy with context-aware translations; shared app primitives and one authoritative documentation/feature tree</li>
</ol>
